$ container --version
container CLI version 1.5.0

# Taken 2026-10-01 by asking the runtime directly: `container build -t <tag> <dir>` over a two-line
# Dockerfile (`FROM alpine:3`, `RUN tail /dev/zero`), which takes all the memory the builder has.
# Exit 1, all output on stderr. The kind in the closing line is `resourceExhausted`; the words after
# it are the step's own (`cannot allocate memory`).

$ container build -t inu150-bres:test bres
